instruction.text: There are many dangerous situations on the road. This means that you must always be careful and pay attention. Select the danger for the cyclist.
The car wants to turn into the same lane as the cyclist. How should the cyclist react? Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: To safely pass by the car, the cyclist should cycle more ((++slowly quickly)) and hold ((++eye_contact hands)) with the driver.

instruction.text: What should you pay attention to in this situation? Select the danger for the cyclist.
The passenger didn’t notice the cyclist and suddenly opened their car door. The cyclist almost crashed into it. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: For this reason, cyclists should cycle ((++slowly quickly)) past parked cars and keep a ((++good small)) distance.

instruction.text: Which situation do you think is safer? Select the correct image.

feedback.end: Correct! It’s safer when two cyclists travel next to each other, as long as it’s on the correct side of the road. This makes it easier for cars to see them.

Correct! You’re safest when closer to the side of the road. This way, cars can pass you and leave a safer gap. However, you should still keep a little distance from the edge to avoid drains and gutters.

atoms.b: Another ((++danger vehicle)) is the blind spot. The blind spot is the area that a road user in another vehicle ((++cannot can)) see.
When you’re behind a car, the driver can see you in their ((++rear_window sunroof)), but it is important to remember that lorry and van drivers would not be able to see you.
As a road user, you should always ((++avoid try)) being in the blind spot of vehicles!

instruction.text: Is the cyclist in the blind spot of the lorry?

atoms.b: The cyclist is not in the blind spot. The driver can see her in the ((++wing_mirror rear_window)).

instruction.text: Is the cyclist in the blind spot of the lorry?

atoms.b: The cyclist is in the blind spot. The driver ((++cannot can_partially)) see her in the wing mirror.

instruction.text: Is the cyclist in the blind spot of the lorry?

atoms.b: The cyclist is in the blind spot. The driver cannot see her when she is cycling ((++behind in_front_of)) the vehicle because the lorry has no rear window.

atoms.text: The blind spots of vehicles that want to turn left are particularly dangerous.

instruction.text: Drag the cyclist to a place where the lorry driver can see him in the wing mirror while turning.
